learn.title: Four-sided figures
learn.body: A quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides. The angles of any quadrilateral add to $360^\circ$, because a diagonal splits it into two triangles of $180^\circ$ each. Special quadrilaterals have extra properties you can use.

learn.title: Parallelograms
learn.body: A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides. Opposite sides are equal, opposite angles are equal, and angles next to each other add to $180^\circ$. Its diagonals cut each other in half.

learn.title: Rectangle, rhombus, square
learn.body: A rectangle is a parallelogram with four right angles, and its diagonals are equal. A rhombus is a parallelogram with four equal sides, and its diagonals cross at right angles. A square is both a rectangle and a rhombus.

learn.title: Trapezoid and kite
learn.body: A trapezoid has one pair of parallel sides. A kite has two pairs of equal sides that sit next to each other, and its diagonals cross at right angles.

learn.title: Use the properties
steps: Parallelogram with one angle $70^\circ$: the next angle is $180-70=110^\circ$.

questions.prompt: What do the angles of any quadrilateral add to?
questions.explanation: A diagonal splits a quadrilateral into two triangles, $2\cdot180=360$.

questions.prompt: A parallelogram has an angle of $70^\circ$. Find the angle next to it in degrees.
questions.explanation: Neighbouring angles of a parallelogram add to $180^\circ$.

questions.prompt: Which quadrilateral always has four equal sides?
questions.explanation: A rhombus has four equal sides. A rectangle has four right angles but only opposite sides equal.

questions.prompt: A rhombus has side length 6. Find its perimeter.
Three angles of a quadrilateral are $90^\circ$, $80^\circ$ and $100^\circ$. Find the fourth in degrees.

questions.explanation: A square has four right angles, so it is a rectangle. The reverse fails because a rectangle can have unequal sides.

questions.prompt: The diagonals of a rhombus cross at \_\_ angles.
questions.explanation: The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular.

questions.prompt: Match each shape to a property.
questions.explanation: These properties are what separate the four families.
